dedupe_keys.name: pypsa spain national energy system model

description: PyPSA-Spain adapts the PyPSA-Eur workflow to model the Spanish energy system at higher national detail. Its maintainers publish source code, configuration and instructions for a national model that uses Spanish datasets and prices from neighbouring countries computed in a wider European run. Inputs include electricity assets, demand, renewable profiles, technology assumptions and policy constraints. Outputs are optimised investment, dispatch and energy flows for the configured planning years and hourly resolution. Geographic coverage is Spain with cross-border price assumptions, not all of Europe. The README states that the fork's software is MIT-licensed; individual input datasets may carry different terms. A limitation is that the national result inherits uncertainty from the PyPSA-Eur workflow and the cross-border prices. The model supports electricity transition and capacity-expansion studies. The catalogue's model-pypsa-eur is the broader parent model; this Spanish configuration adds national sources and functions and is not recorded there as the same resource. No input dataset was downloaded or scenario run.
licence: MIT for code; input-data terms vary
